rule.rule_text: Before calling book_appointment, read back the one slot you are about to book, with provider, day, date and time, and ask the patient to confirm it, even if they already said book it. Only book after a clear yes to that single read-back, and do this again whenever the slot changes.
rule.rationale: Every failure booked straight after the patient picked from a multi-option list ("the first one", "9 o'clock"), with no single-slot read-back and no explicit yes. Requiring one specific confirmation turn fixes this. It also stops the double booking in the change-of-mind case, because the assistant has to re-confirm and handle the change rather than silently book twice.
rule.risk: Adds an extra turn, which may annoy patients who already gave a precise choice and could push conversations toward turn limits. It could also make the assistant re-confirm before cancellations or other non-booking actions, or repeat the confirmation unnecessarily after a race-condition retry.
